basin_time_window_sampler.rationale: dmg.core.data.data.random_index and select_subset cleanly handle 730-day window slicing across CAMELS forcing/target arrays.

warmup_scored_split.rationale: The 365d warmup + 365d scored period partition aligns with standard hydrological dPL training practice.

mini_batch_organization.rationale: Batch tensor shape [730, B=100, features] directly maps to [B=100, 730, features] on GPU.

loss_masking.rationale: Criterion classes (KgeBatchLoss, NseBatchLoss, MSELoss) handle missing target observations with boolean masks.

training_loop.rationale: Trainer.train_one_epoch provides standard epoch/batch iteration, loss logging, backward, and optimizer stepping.

optimizer_and_checkpointing.rationale: Standard PyTorch optimizers (Adam, Adadelta) and torch.save/load state dict checkpointing.

validation_loop.rationale: Full-horizon continuous evaluation under with torch.no_grad(): across held-out basins.

structure_dimension_organization_strateg.recommended_strategy: Fixed structure s per mini-batch with 100 parallel basin-time windows
structure_dimension_organization_strateg.rationale: Each FUSE structure has a unique GraphSignature and compiled Inductor step function (_compiled_step). Fixing the structure per mini-batch allows all 100 basin-time windows to execute the single compiled vmap step at maximum GPU saturation with zero graph recompilations. Structures are sampled or alternated across mini-batches/epochs.
structure_dimension_organization_strateg.rejected_alternative: Mixing multiple structures within a single batch would break vmap/Inductor fullgraph compilation and require slow dynamic branching inside the Python timestep loop.
